title: PenguinUp
tagline: Sports focused Replays and Livestreams software with WiFi cameras
description: WiFi cameras are installed in clubs and people will be able to watch the games live from the app, and after the game everyone will have the possibility of watching the games replays. For those clubs interested in having it, the cameras are installed by the team and after that they can receive technical support if needed. The service payment is monthly and it can be done from any chain and token.
how_its_made:
In order to work, WiFi cameras are installed in the club, and by connecting with the low-level api an hls url is received, which is then recorded in a server using FFmpeg to store it in @Filecoin using @Fleek.

The frontend is a next.js app hosted in @Fleek, which is also used for @ENS domain management and other domains in the future.

Clubs are created from a factory contract, the transaction is subsidized by the team. Clients receive an address representing their club to which they have to send a monthly amount of DAI to keep saving the replays. @Squid is integrated for allowing them to pay with any token and from any chain
